title: Lighting fixture count on a reflected ceiling plan
prompt: Reflected ceiling plan E-201 shows a single open area. Type 'A' fixtures are 2x4 recessed LED troffers, drawn as a rectangle tagged 'A'. Exit signs are tagged 'EX' and emergency lights are tagged 'EM'. Count ONLY the Type 'A' troffers — do not count exit signs (EX) or emergency lights (EM). Emit the total as a single quantity named 'Type A troffer' in 'ea'.
